subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Crisis Management Plans
description: A quick win: understand Crisis Management Plans.

hook.text: The warehouse floods at 2 AM. Who gets called? What happens first? Without a plan, chaos takes over.

buildup.text: A crisis management plan defines roles, communication protocols, and action steps for major disruptions.

discovery.text: It assigns a crisis team, sets escalation triggers, and pre-identifies backup suppliers and alternate routes.

twist.text: A plan nobody practices is useless. Teams that never drilled their response fumble when the real crisis hits.

climax.text: Companies that rehearse crisis plans quarterly respond 2–3x faster than those that only write them.

punchline.text: The plan doesn't help if nobody knows it exists.

quiz.question: How often should crisis plans be practiced?
